Title: Tamil Nadu's first budget under CM Vijay-led govt to be presented in first week of August: Minister Maria Wilson
Synopsis: Tamil Nadu's first budget under the new administration will be presented in early August. Chief Minister Joseph Vijay has been holding extensive review meetings with ministers and officials. The government aims to facilitate education loans for over one lakh students by 2026-27. Financial constraints will not prevent students from pursuing higher education opportunities. Allegations of corruption in appointments were rejected, with the Chief Minister monitoring the process.

Title: US lawmaker urges review of arms sales to India at Capitol briefing
Synopsis: US lawmakers and experts urged a review of arms sales to India. They cited concerns over alleged transnational repression impacting national security. A bipartisan bill was proposed to address this growing foreign government tactic. Experts warned of organized crime networks used for intimidation and violence. Strategic partnerships should not shield governments from accountability for their actions.

Title: Goa govt plans up to 50% subsidy on EVs for bike taxi, autorickshaw operators
Synopsis: The Goa government will offer up to a 50% subsidy on electric vehicles for licensed motorcycle pilots and autorickshaw operators, while setting up 70 new EV charging stations to boost clean mobility.

Title: Trump vows crackdown on immigrant truckers. How many Indians could be impacted?
Synopsis: President Trump announced plans to replace undocumented immigrant truck drivers with veterans. This proposal could significantly impact many Indian-origin truckers working in the United States. The administration alleges undocumented drivers pose safety risks on American roadways. This initiative follows an ongoing federal crackdown on immigrant truck drivers nationwide. Details on implementation and effective dates for this policy remain undisclosed.

Title: Applying for a US green card? Your fate will be in the hands of Trump's officers
Synopsis: A new public charge rule will assess immigrants' reliance on government aid. Immigration officers will gain broader discretion in evaluating applicants' circumstances. This regulation replaces the Biden-era framework with a case-by-case approach. The rule primarily affects family and employment-based green card applicants. It is scheduled to take effect on September 18, 2026.

Title: CAFE III norms signal faster EV shift in India while balancing automakers concerns: Nomura
Synopsis: CAFE refers to government regulations that require automakers to meet a specific average level of fuel economy or CO₂ emissions across their entire fleet of vehicles sold in a year. Under the draft notification, compliance will be evaluated over FY28-30 and FY30-32, giving manufacturers additional time to phase in electric vehicle (EV) launches.

Title: Trump administration weighs $100,000 bond for some green card applicants
Synopsis: The Trump administration is considering a $100,000 bond for some green card applicants. This proposal aims to ensure immigrants can financially support themselves in the United States. Applicants would likely receive the bond back after becoming US citizens, which takes years. Immigration lawyers express concerns that this could prevent lower-income families from immigrating.

Title: Container traffic to drive growth at Indian ports up to 9% CAGR through FY28: Motilal Oswal
Synopsis: Container traffic is expected to drive Indian port growth through FY28. Coal traffic will likely decline due to domestic production and renewables. Petroleum, oil, and lubricants traffic will see moderate expansion. Iron ore traffic is projected to recover with increased domestic use. Policy support and infrastructure development position India as a maritime hub.

Title: Exclusive: Govt may bring back UPI merchant fee for big businesses
Synopsis: India may reintroduce merchant discount rates for large businesses on UPI transactions. This move aims to address the financial sustainability of digital payment providers. Small merchants and transactions below a certain threshold will likely remain exempt from these charges.

Title: From mediator to marketer: Pakistan lobbies for a bigger US role
Synopsis: Pakistan hired a US lobbying firm to boost security cooperation and minerals investment. The two-year agreement aims to convert goodwill into tangible bilateral benefits for Pakistan. The firm will engage with Congress and government officials, including the Pentagon. Efforts focus on restoring defense dialogue and attracting investment in Pakistan's minerals sector. This initiative seeks to institutionalize the relationship beyond personal connections.

Title: Excise case: HC gives final two weeks to Kejriwal, Sisodia to respond to CBI's plea against discharge
Synopsis: The Delhi High Court has granted a final chance for AAP leaders to respond. They must file their replies within two weeks regarding the CBI's plea. The court deferred the hearing to August 17 and 18 for arguments. This case involves the trial court's order discharging them earlier. Lawyers' work abstention caused delays in the proceedings.

Title: Global Market: China stocks slide as tech sell-off hits mainland markets; Alibaba lifts Hong Kong shares
Synopsis: Mainland China stocks declined on Thursday due to technology sector weakness. Hong Kong equities gained momentum, supported by Alibaba's artificial intelligence integration news. Alibaba shares jumped significantly after announcing its AI model would be integrated into Apple devices. This development boosted optimism around China's domestic artificial intelligence ecosystem. Investors are also watching for economic policy signals from an upcoming Politburo meeting.

Title: US imposing 25% tariff on some Brazilian imports starting July 22, citing unfair trade practices
Synopsis: The United States announced a new 25 percent tariff on various Brazilian imports. This measure is set to take effect on July 22, impacting trade policies. Certain products like beef and coffee will be exempted from these new duties. US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer cited unfair trading practices by Brazil. The United States remains open to negotiations for long-needed policy changes.

Title: Don’t become an alcoholic: India’s ethanol push risks solving one problem while creating another
Synopsis: India's push for E20 fuel presents both benefits and drawbacks for vehicular efficiency. Ethanol offers cleaner burning properties but reduces mileage due to lower fuel density. Producing ethanol requires substantial land and water resources, impacting food and environmental security. The country's long-term energy needs are better served by investing in renewable technologies. Future energy security will rely on electric, solar, nuclear, or hydrogen-powered solutions.

Title: Fed's Cook says she is prepared to act soon if inflation does not begin to slow
Synopsis: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook signalled readiness to act if inflation fails to ease, while allowing more time to assess trends. She flagged rising risks from AI investment, tariffs and geopolitical tensions. With inflation still above target, markets are increasingly factoring in the possibility of a rate hike later this year.

Title: India bonds recover on softer US rate outlook; oil risk caps gains
Synopsis: Indian government bonds experienced a positive turnaround on Wednesday, recovering from previous dips as soft inflation data from the US eased rate hike apprehensions. However, higher crude oil prices exerted upward pressure on US yields, which limited market gains. Steady buying from state banks and foreign entities bolstered bonds, though traders continue to navigate inflationary and fiscal uncertainties.

Title: India-UK CETA, not quite the king's ransom expected from a landmark trade deal
Synopsis: Under the India-Britain CETA, Indian exporters could tap into new market avenues, with Britain's Department of International Trade predicting significant growth in trade by 2040. Nevertheless, small export businesses may struggle with adherence to British regulations. Additionally, this agreement may restrict India's policy-making abilities concerning critical development aims, igniting worries over access to affordable medications and control over the digital economy landscape.

Title: Aadhaar alone can't determine victim's age in accident claims: Chhattisgarh HC
Synopsis: Chhattisgarh High Court ruled insurers are not liable before policy issuance. The court found the tribunal wrongly used Aadhaar for age determination. This decision enhanced compensation for accident victims and their families. The court revised disability assessment for an injured claimant significantly. The ruling clarified insurance contract commencement dates and age proof requirements.

Title: Input tax credit relief for companies on staff cars, insurance likely
Synopsis: Companies may soon claim input tax credit on employee vehicles. Group health and life insurance policies for staff are also included. The GST Council's law committee proposed these changes last week. These proposals aim to ease business operations and reduce costs. The GST Council will consider these reforms in an upcoming meeting.

Title: Oil spike jolts Indian bonds, 10-year yield hits three-week high
Synopsis: On Tuesday, Indian government bonds faced a notable downturn, with the benchmark 10-year yield climbing to a three-week peak as global market anxiety intensified. The recent spike in oil prices following tensions in the U.S.-Iran relationship has shaken investor confidence, resulting in a weaker rupee and declining stock values in Mumbai. Attention now turns to an impending decision on including Indian bonds in the global index.

Title: Education-loan AUM of NBFCs seen up 20 pc despite slower US biz: Report
Synopsis: Education loan assets for NBFCs are projected to grow steadily at twenty percent this fiscal year. Diversification across study destinations offsets demand impact from US policy uncertainties. Asset quality remains robust and is expected to stay stable during this period. US-linked disbursements declined sharply, while UK and other destinations gained traction. The US share of education loan assets fell significantly as of March 31, 2026.

Title: Maharashtra withdraws 2023 circular on minor mineral levy during land development
Synopsis: Maharashtra government withdrew a May 2023 circular on minor mineral royalty. This move provides relief to developers facing legal disputes over the framework. The earlier policy faced challenges for inconsistency with court judgments. A fresh, transparent framework will be framed after considering judicial directions. Until then, a new procedure for excavation permissions will be issued.

Title: Govt, industry brainstorms on ways to achieve $150 bn exports target for electronics
Synopsis: Deliberations were held with industry stakeholders on achieving the USD 150 billion electronics exports target. India's policy framework must provide predictability and stability for global value chains to expand. Participants emphasized integrating MSMEs into global value chains to enable scaling as suppliers. Harmonization of HS Codes and closer coordination with Customs authorities were also discussed.

Title: Warsh task force members get an A at the outset, but results will need broad buy-in
Synopsis: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has enlisted a team of fifteen renowned external experts to spearhead reform task forces. This diverse group features both foreign central bankers and individuals from the former Obama administration, emphasizing the strength of expertise compared to other independent agencies. Warsh aims to wrap up this review process by year's end, marking a pivotal move towards possible institutional and policy overhauls.

Title: Wall Street banks rule on staff betting on prediction markets, sources say
Synopsis: In a significant move, major Wall Street banks have revised their employee conduct guidelines. The updated policies impose restrictions on engaging in financial and political prediction markets. Specifically, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have enacted firm prohibitions, while JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America have also established comparable limitations. These initiatives are designed to eliminate conflicts of interest and maintain compliance with industry standards.

Title: US Fed appoints Marc Andreessen to co-lead productivity, jobs task force to assess economic impact of new technologies
Synopsis: The US Federal Reserve has formed five task forces to modernize its monetary policy framework. Marc Andreessen will co-lead a task force examining technology's economic impact. These groups will provide independent recommendations to the Federal Open Market Committee. Prominent global economists and policymakers are participating in these important panels.

Title: Goldman bans staff from participating in finance, politics prediction markets, source says
Synopsis: Goldman Sachs has prohibited staff from trading prediction market contracts. These contracts are linked to financial markets and political events. The policy aims to prevent conflicts of interest with the bank. Violations could lead to disciplinary action and forfeiture of gains. Restrictions do not apply to sports and entertainment prediction markets.

Title: California co-founder of $8 billion asset management firm fired for skipping his own return-to-office rule, now seeks $30 million
Synopsis: A co-founder of California-based Bramshill Investments, an $8 billion asset management firm, has sued after being fired for allegedly violating the company's own five-day return-to-office policy. William Nieporte claims the mandate was used to push him out of the business and is seeking at least $30 million in damages.

Title: Global Market: Japan's 10-year bond yield hits 30-year high as inflation, fiscal concerns weigh
Synopsis: Japan's benchmark 10-year government bond yield reached its highest level in nearly three decades. This surge occurred as oil prices climbed, fueling inflation worries among investors. Shorter-dated bond yields also increased, reflecting broader market pressures. Investors are watching a significant government bond auction scheduled for later today. Concerns over fiscal policy and potential inflation are driving these market movements.

Title: Govt plans fresh policy interventions to strengthen MSME manufacturing ecosystem
Synopsis: The ministry has launched a nationwide consultation exercise to strengthen the MSME ecosystem and their manufacturing base; it has received more than 2,000 suggestions so far, says Mercy Epao, Joint Secretary, MSME ministry.

Title: From Chicken's Neck to growth corridor: Why North Bengal's next chapter matters
Synopsis: North Bengal is emerging as a vital economic corridor, connecting trade and regional integration. Bagdogra Airport's expansion signals growing confidence in business and urban development. Upgraded infrastructure and new policy initiatives support this economic transformation. Siliguri is evolving into a regional hub, creating economic value beyond its transit role. A new generation of entrepreneurs is building globally relevant businesses from the region.

Title: 'My manager keeps trying to lower my salary every time I relocate': Remote worker says pay cut threats have made them afraid to move despite heavy workload
Synopsis: A remote worker says repeated threats of salary cuts every time they relocate have left them afraid to move, despite taking on a heavier workload and seeing coworkers receive raises. The employee shared their dilemma on Reddit ahead of a performance review, asking how to discuss pay and career growth without sounding entitled.

Title: 'Turning up the heat on the streets': Mullin warns protesters, says 'ICE crackdown will intensify'
Suits & Sayings: Hot Issue
Synopsis: ET’s roundup of the wackiest whispers in corporate corridors

Title: US Fed official warns of 'broad-based' inflation as firms urge action
Synopsis: A top Federal Reserve official said Friday that stubbornly high inflation is her bigger concern right now, warning that firms are urging the US central bank to act against rising prices. "Persistently high inflation is the bigger concern," she said.

Title: Hang Seng crashes over 2% as tech selloff hits Asia markets. Why Hong Kong stocks are falling on Friday?
Synopsis: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index fell 2% by midday on Friday, weighed down by a global selloff in technology stocks as renewed inflation concerns dampened risk appetite. The Hang Seng Tech Index plunged 4%, with investors reducing exposure to technology and other growth stocks amid fears that higher inflation could lead to tighter monetary policy and higher interest rates.

Title: ISRO revises voluntary retirement, resignation norms for scientists linked to Gaganyaan, key missions
Synopsis: ISRO has revised rules for personnel seeking to leave their positions. Requests from scientists on Gaganyaan and other vital projects require special approval. This change follows a noticeable increase in such departure requests. Centre Directors must now forward all relevant applications for final decisions. These new instructions aim to ensure project continuity and national importance.

Title: 'Poisonous Far-Left masked as equality': Rubio calls out extremist groups as US hosts global meet
'Urgent Need to Collaborate': NSA Ajit Doval flags multi-domain threats & supply chain disruptions
Australia to tighten scrutiny of Big Four Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG after wave of scandals
Synopsis: Australia will enhance its oversight of major accounting firms following recent governance issues. The government has directed the Australian Securities and Investments Commission to improve sector regulation. This move aims to boost accountability and transparency within the audit industry. Several Big Four firms have faced scandals and investigations in recent years. Breaking up these firms is also being considered as a potential option.

Title: UK nationalises Chinese-owned British Steel to protect nation's steelmaking capacity
Synopsis: The United Kingdom government has nationalised British Steel to secure its steelmaking capacity. This move protects thousands of jobs and the nation's vital supply of domestically produced steel. The government took operational control after the Chinese owners considered closing the plant's blast furnaces. These furnaces are the last in the UK to produce virgin steel from raw materials. An evaluation will determine compensation for the former owner, Jingye Group.

Title: Policies Aren’t Enough to Retain Top Talent. You Need Systems.
Synopsis: Enduring talent retention is driven not by isolated HR policies or industry norms but by the presence of coherent, integrated systems in which hiring, compensation, advancement, and retention practices reinforce one another. An analysis of nearly one million workers across 1,500 firms in Singapore demonstrates that companies with aligned and complementary talent strategies achieve dramatically higher employee loyalty and earnings, while those relying on single, progressive measures—such as lowering degree requirements or boosting pay—often fall short of lasting results. True organizational culture and long-term workforce stability emerge from the internal coherence of core practices, not from mission statements or standalone initiatives, as evidenced by the experiences of firms operating in a highly competitive economy.

Title: Global growth set to slow to 2.5% and India 'will lose a step too': Moody's Analytics
Synopsis: Moody's Analytics expects global growth to slow to 2.5% in 2026, saying India too "will lose a step" amid a broader moderation in activity. The report said the AI boom has prevented a steeper downturn but warned that geopolitical tensions, trade frictions and inflation continue to pose downside risks to the global economy.

Title: Can a woman be denied maternity leave after having twins under two-child policy? Telangana HC ruling answers
Synopsis: The Telangana High Court ruled against denying maternity leave for a second pregnancy. This decision came after a woman's first pregnancy resulted in twins. The court emphasized protecting women's health and continued employment. A rigid interpretation of the two-child norm was deemed detrimental to the leave's purpose. The petitioner was granted her maternity leave and full salary benefits.

Title: China and Xi are seen more favorably than the US and Trump in many nations, new survey says
Synopsis: Global opinions have shifted, with China now viewed more favorably than the United States. More countries now prefer China's leadership over President Donald Trump's. This marks a significant change in international perceptions over twenty years. Tensions with allies and U.S. foreign policy actions contributed to this shift. China is increasingly seen as a more reliable global partner.

Title: Amazon to launch its satellite internet in South Africa, seemingly beating out Musk in his homeland
Synopsis: Amazon will launch its satellite internet service, Amazon Leo, in South Africa by 2027. This move positions Amazon ahead of Elon Musk's rival Starlink in the African market. Amazon is partnering with South African provider Herotel for this significant continental launch. The South African government has officially backed this new technology agreement. This launch marks Amazon's initial step in expanding its service across Africa.

Title: 'The education system failed the Black community’: Rep. Menefee clashes with Republican DEI witness
ICICI Pru Life Q1 Result: Net profit jumps 28% YoY to Rs 386 crore
Synopsis: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance reported a twenty-eight percent net profit increase. Net premium income rose to nine thousand seven hundred forty-nine crore rupees. New business premium grew by twenty-one percent, and policy numbers also increased. Total revenue reached twenty-eight thousand three hundred ninety-five crore rupees. The company proposed changing its name to ICICI Life Insurance Ltd.

Title: Nimbus group targets tier-2 expansion, signs MoU for Mathura township
Synopsis: Nimbus Group has signed an MoU to develop an integrated township in Mathura under the Uttar Pradesh Township Policy, 2023, as it expands its presence beyond the NCR. The realty developer is also exploring projects in Tier II and III cities, including Meerut, Vrindavan, Hapur, Rudrapur, Muzaffarnagar, Bareilly and Rohtak.

Title: China's latest 'shock', German auto pain and the euro/yuan pressure cooker
Synopsis: China's export engine is posting a large trade surplus, defying global challenges and trade tensions. Chinese exports climbed significantly in June, driven by tech and surging automobile sales. Europe faces immense pressure from these imports and rising energy prices. German automakers are particularly impacted, considering job cuts and reduced sales. Policymakers are now examining exchange rates as a potential solution to these economic imbalances.

Title: India well placed to anchor Asia's value chains: FECC
Synopsis: GEC East in Singapore focuses on advancing international economic cooperation through dialogue. The forum brings together leaders to discuss the next phase of economic partnerships. India is well-positioned to become an anchor for regional value chains. Manufacturing and industrial policy discussions emphasize integrated regional ecosystems. Supply chain resilience is a key focus for critical economic sectors.

Title: 'COVID vaccine has worst side effects ever': Dr Rogers' explosive claim rocks fiery Senate hearing
US consumer inflation likely increased at a slow pace in June as gasoline prices retreated
Synopsis: U.S. consumer inflation probably slowed in June, but rate hikes remain possible. Gasoline prices retreated from highs after a fragile ceasefire took hold. This truce collapsed, causing prices to reverse course and rise again. Higher food prices are also expected due to conflict and weather conditions. Core inflation, excluding food and energy, showed moderate increases.

Title: Gold slides over 1% as oil surges on Strait of Hormuz closure fears
Synopsis: Gold prices declined over one percent in early Asian trade Monday. Oil prices jumped sharply, increasing inflation concerns and interest rate expectations. U.S. and Iranian forces exchanged missile and drone assaults in the Gulf region. Federal Reserve chair testimony and economic data will offer policy clues. Gold speculators reduced net long positions while China increased its reserves.

Title: Rs 1 lakh crore risk: Oil Ministry plays cost card to defend E20
Synopsis: Defending its policy, the government warned of the risk of stranding massive investments made in ethanol infrastructure over the past few years. “If, after creating this capacity, we were to arbitrarily revert to E10, what happens to these investments?” the ministry asked.

Title: Why Delhi needs to take a deeper breath
Synopsis: Delhi's new electric vehicle policy aims to boost clean mobility and reduce pollution. The policy offers incentives and mandates for electric two and three-wheelers. However, it faces challenges from external vehicle traffic and non-exhaust emissions. Achieving clean mobility requires integrating mass public transport and promoting non-motorised options. Private vehicles should not remain the primary travel choice for all journeys.

Title: West Bengal unveils industry push as Mitsubishi eyes chip unit
Synopsis: Mitsubishi executives met with West Bengal officials regarding a semiconductor unit. The state government is preparing a new industrial policy for growth. This policy will focus on modernizing traditional industries and encouraging new sectors. The government aims to make West Bengal a preferred investment destination. They will offer industrial incentives to attract businesses and create jobs.

Title: Backlash on ethanol-blend fuel intensifies in India, puts carmakers in the dock
Synopsis: India's mandatory E20 fuel policy faces public backlash and political opposition. Car owners report reduced mileage and potential vehicle damage from the new fuel. The government asserts E20 reduces crude oil imports and aids farmers. Opposition leaders demand clarity from automakers regarding vehicle compatibility with E20. This policy, implemented nationwide, has reignited concerns about its rapid rollout.

Title: RBI backs crypto ban, tax department warns of evasion risks, documents show
Synopsis: India's central bank has reiterated its preference for a cryptocurrency policy "leaning towards prohibition," warning that crypto assets and stablecoins could threaten financial stability and monetary sovereignty, according to internal government documents reviewed by Reuters.

Title: Global Market: Japanese bond yields climb to multi-decade highs amid inflation and fiscal concerns
Synopsis: Japanese government bond yields surged to multi-decade highs as investors grew concerned over persistent inflation, rising government spending and uncertainty over the future path of Bank of Japan monetary policy. The benchmark 20-year JGB yield climbed to its highest level since 1996, reflecting growing worries about Japan’s fiscal outlook and borrowing needs.

Title: Pakistan, China to tighten border security, immigration controls: officials
Synopsis: Pakistan and China will strengthen cooperation in immigration and border management. A joint working group will be established to enhance security and efficiency. Both nations aim to expedite immigration processes and combat illegal activities. China will continue supporting capacity building for Pakistani institutions.

Title: Tripura launches Census 2027 self-enumeration, Governor leads by example
Synopsis: Tripura initiated the Census of India 2027 self-enumeration process on Friday. Governor Indra Sena Reddy Nallu inaugurated the exercise by completing his own details online. The self-enumeration phase will continue until July 31 across the state. House listing and enumeration will follow from August 1 to August 30. Population enumeration is scheduled for February 2027.

Title: Who is Andy Burnham? Meet the 'King of the North' poised to become Britain's next Prime Minister. Here's all about his life, family and career
Synopsis: Andy Burnham has been elected as the new leader of Britain's Labour Party. He is expected to become the country's next prime minister next week. Burnham, known as the 'King of the North', champions regional development and economic revival. His political style is approachable, focusing on community-based policies. He aims to replicate his regional success across the entire United Kingdom.

Title: China calls US visa regulations 'discriminatory', threatens countermeasures
Synopsis: China has urged the United States to withdraw its new discriminatory visa regulations. Beijing stated it reserves the right to take reciprocal countermeasures against the US. The United States moved on Thursday to tighten visa durations for foreign students. Cultural exchange visitors and journalists will also face shorter visa periods. China rejects these US decisions, stating they serve no one's interests.

Title: Opposition leaders to meet on July 20 to finalise strategy for Monsoon Session
Synopsis: Leaders of Opposition parties in the Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha will meet on July 20 (Monday), the opening day of the Monsoon Session of Parliament, to chalk out a joint strategy for the session.

Title: Maharashtra Motor Vehicle Aggregator Rules 2026 notified: From surge pricing to private carpooling to Rs 1 crore penalty, what changes for Ola, Uber, Rapido users
Synopsis: Maharashtra has notified new rules for app-based transport services, bringing aggregators under a uniform framework. These regulations mandate licensing and introduce fare controls, impacting services like Ola and Uber. Passenger safety measures and driver welfare provisions are significantly strengthened by these new rules. Vehicle eligibility criteria and mandatory safety features are also detailed within the notification. The government aims for a safer and more accountable app-based transport ecosystem.

Title: Explained: 3 reasons why South Korea's Kospi crashed 6% today
Synopsis: South Korea's Kospi index experienced a significant decline of over six percent on Thursday. This downturn followed the Bank of Korea's first interest rate increase in three years. Major tech stocks like SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics saw substantial drops. Concerns are mounting over the impact of single-stock leveraged ETFs on market stability. Regulators are reviewing measures for these high-risk investment products.

Title: Delhi to be developed into education hub: CM Rekha Gupta
Synopsis: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta stressed instilling national pride in school children. This patriotism is crucial for higher education and building a developed India. Gupta highlighted developing Delhi as a national education hub for students. Shaheed Bhagat Singh College celebrated its diamond jubilee with university officials. The college's principal urged students to become job creators and societal contributors.

Title: Pakistan urges US, Iran to end hostilities, resume talks amid renewed strikes
Synopsis: Pakistan urged the United States and Iran to cease hostilities and resume negotiations. Renewed military strikes between the two nations threaten regional stability and peace efforts. The Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding aimed for a permanent peace agreement within sixty days. Pakistan reiterated its call for maximum restraint and a commitment to dialogue. The ongoing tensions are impacting global oil prices and regional security.

Title: RedBus, travel co ordered to pay Rs 10,000 compensation after man's Rs 600 ticket was cancelled 17 minutes before departure
Synopsis: A consumer commission found RedBus and Bharmani Travels jointly responsible for a cancelled bus ticket. The complainant's ticket was cancelled just seventeen minutes before departure, leaving him stranded. He was forced to book an expensive emergency flight to reach his destination that night. The commission stated online platforms cannot escape responsibility after accepting payment and confirming bookings. Both companies were ordered to pay compensation for harassment and financial losses incurred.

Title: US says it will not block Maria Corina Machado's return to Venezuela
Synopsis: The United States will not prevent Maria Corina Machado from returning to Venezuela. A US diplomat stated that conditions must be right for her safe arrival. Machado has been unable to return to Caracas after leaving in December. The US has made its position clear to interim Venezuelan authorities. Venezuela's interim president announced plans to meet with opposition party members soon.

Title: Tata Motors flags concerns on CAFE II credit proposal
Synopsis: Tata Motors has raised concerns regarding the government's proposed direct credit sales by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency. The automaker believes this move could distort price discovery and devalue genuine efficiency credits. It argues that BEE should administer the market instead of selling credits directly. This provision may offer a cheaper compliance option than statutory penalties. The company also requested that earned credits should be allowed to carry forward.

Title: Files relating to India's largest nuclear power plant Kudankulam exposed in data breach
Synopsis: Ransomware group World Leaks posted sensitive data from India's largest nuclear plant. Reliance Group confirmed a partial data breach on a third-party server. The breach could pose serious risks to the plant's safety. Indian authorities and cybersecurity agencies are investigating the incident thoroughly. This incident highlights growing cyber threats faced by Indian companies.

Title: Files relating to India's largest nuclear power plant Kudankulam exposed in data breach
Synopsis: Indian businessman Anil Ambani's Reliance Group, one of the plant's contractors, told Reuters in a statement that there had been a "partial breach" of its data on a server hosted by third-party Indian data centre service provider Yotta, and that the government has been informed about the incident.

Title: US Senate Democrats block $1.15 trillion defense bill over Iran war objections
Synopsis: Senate Democrats blocked a defense policy bill due to Iran war concerns. They cited President Trump's lack of congressional consultation on military actions. The bill failed to gain enough votes to advance in the Senate. Republicans urged support, stating the bill ensures military readiness. This setback occurs early in the legislative process for the defense bill.

Title: ‘I don’t see US as the winner’: Rep Lynch torches Kevin Warsh over Fed’s approach towards AI
Higher education bill may not improve autonomy of HEIs, treats courses inconsistently: Think tank
Synopsis: A legislative think tank analysis suggests the Viksit Bharat Shiksha Adhishthan Bill, 2025, may not significantly improve higher education autonomy. The bill proposes a unified regulatory commission, dissolving existing bodies like UGC and AICTE. It inconsistently applies to various professional courses, exempting legal and medical programs. Grounds for removing part-time council members are not specified, raising concerns about delegation.

Title: India's CPI inflation may average 5% in FY27; stable rupee, RBI policy to help contain price pressures: SBI Research
Synopsis: India's retail inflation is expected to average 5% in FY27, with the RBI likely to keep interest rates unchanged for an extended period, according to SBI Research. The report projects CPI inflation at 5.1% in Q2, 5.7% in Q3 and 5.1% in Q4, with a stable rupee and improving foreign inflows helping contain imported inflation.

Title: German yields hit 2-year high as Middle East conflict stokes inflation fears
Synopsis: German two-year bond yields reached their highest point since July 2024. This rise occurred as Middle East conflict fears boosted inflation and interest rate expectations. Money markets now anticipate the European Central Bank raising its deposit rate significantly. Oil prices also climbed due to renewed U.S. naval blockades of Iran. Investors await U.S. inflation data and Federal Reserve testimony for further guidance.

Title: India bonds join global rout after Mideast escalation jolts oil higher
Synopsis: Indian government bonds declined early Tuesday amid rising oil prices. Fresh Gulf strikes obstructed shipping, causing Brent crude to climb significantly. This surge in oil prices threatens to increase India's inflation and interest rate risks. Foreign investors sold Indian bonds, marking their first sale since June policy measures. The rupee also dropped, reflecting concerns over the escalating geopolitical situation.

Title: GE Vernova, Atlanta Electricals among top beneficiaries of India's transmission expansion
Synopsis: India's power transmission sector anticipates growth, with new policies supporting domestic manufacturing. Chinese firms can participate, but strict localization rules will ensure local content. Supply constraints in transformers are expected to ease, benefiting grid equipment suppliers. Demand for transmission infrastructure remains strong, especially for high-voltage equipment. GE Vernova and Atlanta Electricals are positioned to benefit from this expansion.

Title: RBI rate hike: Interest burden for Indians may go up later this year amid inflation risks
Synopsis: The Reserve Bank of India is poised to keep its policy rates steady in the short term. Nonetheless, BofA Securities predicts that rising concerns over domestic inflation could lead to increased rates in the future. Revisions to FY27 economic growth projections indicate a stronger demand trend, while external accounts are anticipated to show improvement with a reduced current account deficit.

Title: India Inc urges US Trade Representative to drop tariff plan on Indian goods
Synopsis: In separate submissions to the USTR as part of the ongoing public hearing on the probe (July 7-9), industry bodies said the existing India-US Trade Policy Forum should be used to address concerns instead of imposing tariffs.

Title: Global Market: HSBC cuts gold price forecasts for 2026-27 on hawkish Fed outlook
Synopsis: HSBC has lowered its average gold price forecasts for 2026 and 2027. This adjustment stems from expectations of a stronger U.S. dollar and a hawkish Federal Reserve. The bank anticipates gold trading within a specific range for the remainder of 2026. Central bank purchases have moderated, though long-term diversification offers support. Despite forecast reductions, downside risks for gold appear limited.

Title: ADB cuts India FY27 growth forecast to 6.6% on higher energy costs
Synopsis: The Asian Development Bank has lowered India's FY27 growth forecast to 6.6 percent. Higher oil prices and transportation costs are impacting consumer sentiment and private demand. The ADB retained its FY28 growth forecast at 7.3 percent, expecting policy support. South Asia's growth projection for 2026 was also lowered by 0.3 percentage points. India's FY26 inflation forecast was raised to 5.2 percent due to oil and food prices.

Title: Can India's colonial-era state power an AI-driven economy?
Synopsis: India's state structure, designed for control, faces challenges in the current dynamic technological era. Prime Minister Modi's government has improved welfare delivery and infrastructure development significantly. However, future progress requires greater state risk-taking and unleashing entrepreneurial capabilities. Synopsis: Life insurance policy exclusions: Many individuals do not read the life insurance policy exclusions at the time of buying. Not reading and knowing the exclusions can lead to rejection of claims when submitted. Read on to know if your life insurance policy covers death due to war, terror attacks and common life insurance policy exclusions.

Title: ET Prime Special Series: Multibagger or IBC - Part 57: Forging firm that supplies Tata, M&M, JCB. Nobody talks about it enough
Synopsis: For over four decades, one company has been making crankshafts quietly and precisely, supplying customers from Tata Motors to Liebherr to Mahindra. The trouble is: Crankshafts are irrelevant in a battery EV. The company says the EV impact on its heavy-duty components is limited because trucks, tractors, and off-highway vehicles will not electrify as quickly as passenger cars. This is the story of a highly profitable forging company with a nearly 30% EBITDA margin, which is embarking on a fresh capex plan.

Title: Coachella 2027 advance ticket sale announced: How to buy, dates, prices, pass types, and and what fans need to know
Synopsis: Coachella 2027 is already building anticipation with advance ticket sales launching months before the official lineup announcement. Scheduled across two weekends in April at the Empire Polo Field in Indio, California, the festival continues its tradition of early access passes and tier-based pricing. With strong demand expected and resale markets already active, fans are securing tickets early, relying on Coachella’s reputation for delivering top-tier performances and unforgettable live music experiences.

Title: From Asimov to Terminator: The rise of the working robot
Synopsis: Japan Airlines is testing robots for baggage handling at Haneda airport. These robots could also clean aircraft cabins. This move addresses Japan's aging population and tourism surge. Robots are increasingly used globally in various industries. Advances in AI and falling hardware costs make automation more accessible. This trend is expected to continue, impacting employment and productivity worldwide.

Title: Iran's Supreme Leader calls US bases 'paper tiger', questions its regional security capability
Synopsis: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei declared US bases in West Asia are weak. He stated the Persian Gulf's future will exclude America. Khamenei emphasized Iran's role in regional security and maritime routes. Iran submitted a new proposal to the US via Pakistan to end hostilities. The US is reportedly inclined to reject this offer.

Title: Army chief holds key discussions to deepen India-US military ties during Pentagon visit
Synopsis: General Upendra Dwivedi, the Chief of the Indian Army, recently concluded a pivotal visit to the Pentagon where he met with top US military officials. The discussions were aimed at bolstering defense cooperation, with both sides exploring fresh avenues for capability enhancement and coordinated efforts in joint operations.

Title: Infanticide case at Foxconn exposes workplace welfare gaps, spurs calls for reforms
Synopsis: A tragic infanticide at Foxconn's Devanahalli unit highlights critical gaps in mental health awareness, workplace support, and reproductive healthcare for young women in large electronics manufacturing facilities. Experts urge enhanced monitoring, on-campus counseling, comprehensive sex education, and government policy interventions to prevent future incidents and ensure employee wellbeing.

Title: Gold, silver may face selling pressure as Fed meeting, US-Iran talks loom: Analysts
Synopsis: Gold and silver may face some selling pressure this holiday-shortened week as traders track peace talks between the US and Iran, crude oil rates and the Federal Reserve's policy decision, analysts said.

Title: US, EU deepen cooperation on critical minerals to counter China reliance
Synopsis: America and the European Union are boosting cooperation on vital minerals. This partnership aims to reduce dependence on China for materials essential for modern industries. Officials signed an agreement to secure and produce these minerals. A separate trade plan will address unfair practices. This move strengthens transatlantic ties and seeks diverse supply chains for future technologies.

Title: 100% road tax waiver for electric cars priced up to Rs 30 lakh till Mar 2030: Delhi's draft EV policy
Synopsis: Delhi's new electric vehicle policy offers significant benefits. Electric cars priced at Rs 30 lakh or less will receive full road tax and registration fee exemptions until March 2030. Strong hybrid EVs get a 50 percent exemption. From 2027, only electric three-wheelers will be registered. This policy aims to boost EV adoption and improve air quality.

Title: Semenya vows to fight against IOC's gene-screening policy
Synopsis: The International Olympic Committee has introduced a new gender testing policy for female athletes. Double Olympic champion Caster Semenya criticizes the move, calling it a violation of women's rights. Semenya insists there is no scientific basis for the policy. She states athletes with Differences of Sexual Development were not properly consulted. The policy aims to ensure fairness in women's events.

Title: Thousands protest against Trump immigration policies
Synopsis: Thousands of U.S. workers and students protested President Trump's immigration policies nationwide on Tuesday. Demonstrations occurred in cities like Washington and Asheville, with chants against "fascist USA." University and high school students also participated, advocating for refugees and opposing "ICE terror."

Title: #MakeMeHappy, an easy policy directive?
Synopsis: There are powerful leaders, like the 'Yellow-Haired One,' operate on a 'pleasure principle,' prioritizing their own happiness in policy decisions. This 'Me First' approach, where making strong men happy is instinctively understood, becomes a stated policy for 'Mogambo.

Title: Punjab's new industry policy next month
Synopsis: Punjab is set to unveil a new industry policy next month. This policy aims to streamline project clearances, promising approvals within 5 to 45 days. A new Private Industrial Park Policy will also be introduced, enabling private sector participation. These initiatives are expected to boost investment and business growth in the state.

Title: Delhi govt to bring new transparent excise policy: CM Rekha Gupta
Synopsis: Delhi's BJP government, led by Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, is set to introduce a new excise policy, aiming for transparency and revenue generation. Gupta stated the policy will incorporate best practices from other states, avoiding societal issues. This move follows the scrapping of the previous AAP government's policy due to corruption allegations, a key issue for the BJP during elections.

Title: The surprising danger of covering leftovers with aluminum foil
Synopsis: Contrary to popular belief, cats approaching humans often seek security, not just affection or food. Research indicates cats form secure attachments with caretakers, viewing them as a safe base. This understanding is crucial for adoption, as shy cats may be overlooked due to shelter stress, highlighting the importance of patience and creating a secure environment for building trust.

Title: Nifty’s 2 pillars now facing structural headwinds: Ravi Dharamshi's warning on IT & consumption
Synopsis: His warning carries weight. ValueQuest has been quietly repositioning for months by moving capital away from consumption-oriented exposures and steering clear of IT services entirely, even before the geopolitical shock that roiled markets over the past two months.

Title: "Hypocritical behaviour": Iran says US not complying with nuclear non-proliferation treaty
Synopsis: The Iranian mission to the UN has taken a strong stance against American nuclear strategies, asserting Tehran's right to continue its uranium enrichment. In a surprise move, Iran has put forth a new framework aimed at resolving the ongoing West Asia tensions.

Title: Northeast no longer defined by insurgency, isolation: Arunachal CM Pema Khandu
Synopsis: Arunachal Pradesh is transforming significantly. Once seen as isolated, the state is now a focus of national development. Chief Minister Pema Khandu shared this at a New Delhi conference. He highlighted hydropower potential, tourism growth, and governance reforms. Investments in people, education, and opportunities are driving progress. The state is moving forward together.

Title: FDI easing for foreign cos with up to 10 pc Chinese stake to be notified soon under FEMA
Synopsis: India is on the verge of a significant policy alteration, planning to loosen foreign investment regulations for firms that include Chinese stakeholders. This initiative aims to spark a surge in investments, particularly in crucial manufacturing domains, ensuring that proposals enjoy expedited reviews.

Title: Suits & Sayings: At Any Cost
Synopsis: ET’s roundup of the wackiest whispers in corporate corridors.

Title: Rupee hits record closing low of 94.85 vs USD hurt by surging oil, persistent outflows
Synopsis: The Indian rupee fell to a record closing low on Wednesday, pressured by rising oil prices as efforts to end the Iran conflict remained stalled, while persistent foreign selling of Indian assets added to the strain.

Title: India proposes new vehicle rules to allow higher ethanol-blended fuels
Synopsis: India has proposed amendments to its motor vehicle rules to formally integrate higher ethanol-blended fuels, including E85 (85% ethanol) and E100 (nearly pure ethanol). This move follows the nation's achievement of its E20 target and aims to further reduce reliance on expensive petroleum imports.

Title: Pregnant MBA graduate gets big four job, but one fear about the workplace is haunting her. Reddit has a lot to say
Synopsis: A pregnant MBA graduate set to join a Big Four firm in India has sparked a wider debate on workplace bias and maternity support after sharing her concerns online about starting her career while expecting. While she is happy about her “miracle” pregnancy, her main worries revolve around job location, potential discrimination, and how her pregnancy might impact her early professional journey. Despite having a strong support system at home and plans to return to work a few months after delivery, she remains anxious about workplace attitudes and expectations.

Title: Is the RBI fighting the wrong battle? Why rate hikes may not solve India’s current inflation problem
Synopsis: Rising oil prices due to the West Asia conflict have lifted inflation expectations, but underlying demand in India remains weak. Despite market signals pointing to possible rate hikes, historical trends and current macro conditions suggest the RBI may hold off, favouring supportive monetary policy amid fragile growth and supply-driven inflation pressures.

Title: Excise policy case: Kejriwal seeks judge’s recusal; SG Mehta calls plea ‘motivated & juvenile'
Synopsis: Former Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal personally sought the recusal of Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma in the excise policy case, citing apprehension of bias, while the Centre opposed the plea as “motivated” and sought its dismissal.

Title: Delhi draft EV policy offers up to Rs 1 lakh scrapping incentive for e-cars
Synopsis: The benefit will be available for scrapping of Delhi-registered BS-IV and below cars and will be limited to the first 1,00,000 eligible applicants under the policy. For electric four-wheeler goods carriers (N1 trucks), the policy proposes a scrapping incentive of Rs 50,000 under similar conditions, including scrapping of BS-IV and older vehicles and purchase within six months of CoD issuance.

Title: RBI likely to go for a prolonged policy rate pause: ICICI Bank report
Synopsis: ICICI Bank Global Markets said the chances of a policy rate hike are low due to benign core inflation and expects a prolonged pause in rates through 2026-27, with the focus shifting to regular durable liquidity infusion to support monetary transmission.

Title: Are you sure your car insurance is real? Probe finds 80,000 fake policies issued between 2022 and 2023
Synopsis: Delhi Police's crime branch is investigating a large-scale insurance fraud where policies intended for two-wheelers were fraudulently issued for three and four-wheeled vehicles nationwide. Fraudsters exploited the insurance company's e-portal, manipulating data and falsifying vehicle types. Over 80,000 fake policies were issued between 2022 and 2023, resulting in significant financial losses for the company.

Title: RBI MPC policy: The rate is not for exchange, but to support growth
Synopsis: The RBI has shifted its monetary policy stance to "accommodative" and reduced key policy rates, signaling a focus on supporting growth despite global economic challenges. Governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized that the MPC is considering rate cuts, aiming for a 6.5% growth in 2024-25, while minimizing reliance on exchange rate management.

Title: Apple to reinvest Trump tariff refunds in US economy, says Tim Cook
Synopsis: Apple is actively seeking refunds for tariffs it has paid to the U.S. government. According to CEO Tim Cook, any funds recovered will be directed towards fostering American innovation and enhancing advanced manufacturing capabilities. This effort will complement Apple's ongoing investments in the United States. Additionally, several major automotive manufacturers are also looking forward to similar tariff refunds.

Title: Proposed national e-commerce, retail trade policies under discussions: Piyush Goyal
Synopsis: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced revisions to the national e-commerce policy to reflect the sector's rapid evolution. Simultaneously, the retail trade policy is under review due to its interconnectedness with e-commerce. DPIIT has sought input from the National Traders' Welfare Board for the retail policy, aiming to streamline trade, improve ease of business, and promote digitization.

Title: Iran's IRGC announces new rules to strengthen control over Arabian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz
Synopsis: Iran's Revolutionary Guard is tightening its grip on vital waterways. New rules aim to boost control over the Arabian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. This move signals Iran's intent to assert dominance in the region. Supreme Leader Khamenei has also spoken out against foreign military presence. He described US bases as ineffective.

Title: Delhi govt tightens 'no PUC, no fuel' rule, data shows over 15,000 vehicles denied fuel in four days
Synopsis: Delhi is cracking down on polluting vehicles. Over 15,000 cars were denied fuel in just four days for lacking a valid Pollution Under Control certificate. This strict enforcement of the 'no PUC, no fuel' rule aims to combat the city's air quality crisis. The government is ensuring vehicles meet pollution standards to improve air quality for everyone.

Title: Airport operators urge MoCA for urgent relief amid 25% cut charges to compensate revenue loss
Synopsis: Airport operators are requesting urgent government support. A 25 percent cut in landing and parking fees for domestic flights has impacted their cash flow. Operators face revenue losses and operational risks. They seek relief measures from the Ministry of Civil Aviation. This includes deferring payments to AAI. They also suggest increasing User Development Fees.

Title: West Asia War: US says it's hunting for explosive mines in latest push to open Strait of Hormuz
Synopsis: West Asia War: The United States Navy is actively clearing mines from the Strait of Hormuz. This crucial oil shipping route faces disruption. Experts believe mine removal could take months. The presence of mines, real or perceived, impacts global oil trade. Shipping companies and insurers are assessing the risks. The US is taking steps to ensure safe passage for vessels.

Title: Delhi excise policy caused Rs 2,002 crore loss, PAC report tells Assembly
Synopsis: Delhi's former excise policy has been declared a total failure by a Public Accounts Committee report. The policy, implemented by the Aam Aadmi Party government, caused an estimated loss of over Rs 2,000 crore to the state. The committee found the policy to be poorly conceived. Allegations of irregularities led to its withdrawal and a CBI probe.
